messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: p99 embeddings latency > 1.0s in eu-west-1. Affected service: embeddings-relay. Pager: @Dmitri (primary), @Carla (secondary). Alert: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/ALERT-8132. Please ack and follow runbook -> https://runbooks.redwood.ai/relay-evictions.md
Dmitri: acked. jumping in now. tagging Ben in case we need handoff for the rest of the night. initial check: seeing sharp increase in eviction events and CPU on relays.
Ben: available, coming into the bridge. quick thing — which customers are seeing user-facing errors vs degraded latency?
Carla: I'm on standby. UI team reported intermittent 502s for EU embeddings calls ~10:05UTC. No major error spike yet but p99 token gen time is high.
Dmitri: confirmed. I opened ticket INC-4921 to track customer reports & impact (linked to alert). short term plan: 1) increase relay pool in eu-west-1 2) temporarily relax eviction threshold 3) monitor error rate.
Dmitri: running the scale up now:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/relay-eu-west --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod patch configmap relay-config -p '{"data":{"eviction_threshold":"0.95"}}'
```
Ben: noted. I'll watch the gateway logs and verify 502 rate. tailing: `kubectl logs -l app=gateway -c gateway --since=5m | grep 502`
Carla: adding a short dashboard panel (embeddings_relay.evictions, gateway.5xx) and wiring a synthetic probe for eu-west embeddings endpoint. will post link in a min.
ops-scheduler-bot: NOTE: Auto-incremented incident tracking ticket OPS-1987 created for infra follow-up (owner unassigned).
Dmitri: mitigation in place. relays scaled, eviction relaxed. preliminary metrics show p99 down from ~1.4s to ~0.6s over last 3 minutes. error rate 502 -> 0.5% (was 2.4%).
Ben: seeing same in logs, 502s dropping. customers with active sessions should be recovering. marking as partial-mitigated.
Carla: dashboard posted: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/share/abc123 (embeddings latency + evictions). I'll keep the probe running for 30m.
Dmitri: handoff plan for upcoming shift: Primary -> Ben (next 2h), Secondary -> Carla. I'm available as escalator for 1h after handoff. Ben, confirm coverage for 02:00-04:00 UTC?
Ben: confirmed for first 2h. there's an APAC coverage gap 02:00-06:00 UTC (no primary on call). that needs addressing before we declare full coverage.
Eva: I can pick up APAC coverage starting 03:30 UTC and handle escalation if needed. will coordinate with ops-scheduler to adjust rota.
ops-scheduler-bot: FYI: requested shift swap added to draft schedule. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/shifts/2876543
Dmitri: post-handoff action items (short): - Ben: monitor for 2h and confirm resolved, create incident summary message when stable - Carla: keep probe and dashboard up for 30m, collect relevant graphs - Eva: take APAC coverage patch, confirm in scheduler - Infra/Runbooks: OPS-1987 to investigate eviction root cause and harden autoscaler thresholds. I assigned INC-4921 -> OPS-1987 in ticketing.
Ben: I'll open a brief retro invite for Mon 10:00 UTC, add attendees: Eng Runtime, Infra, Product, and Customer Success. I'll also add the quick checklist for future handoffs to the oncall README.
Carla: created short checklist item in runbook: "oncall -> verify probe, scale, patch eviction, notify CS" and linked to runbook snippet.
Dmitri: customer impact: manually verified 3 customer sessions that hit 502s earlier; support notified with message template (CS ticket #CS-7465). awaiting any escalations.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: latency returned to baseline. Incident start_ts=2876543210, resolved_ts=2876550410. Final severity: Sev2 (customer-facing errors intermittent). Linked tickets: INC-4921, OPS-1987, CS-7465.
Eva: :thumbsup: thanks all. I'll confirm shift update and follow up with ops-scheduler.
Ben: leaving detailed thread note in the incident ticket and marking this Slack thread as handoff-complete. will post incident summary there shortly.
Dmitri: thanks team. small gap action item: ops to add APAC backup to rota and infra to add eviction alert throttle. good catch everyone. :rocket:
